method: AI visual inspection of current rendered PNGs plus XML native source editing and sharp/librsvg pixel evidence.
scope: M0 static UI layout diagram technical QA. User approval remains pending; no M1 implementation is implied.

editable-master-reopened.evidence: Root read the real source-edit evidence; QA reviewer viewed the reopened and edited PNGs. XML serialize/parse/reopen preserves native objects and produces zero unchanged-render pixel differences. Native title From interfaces becomes From ideas, and about-introduction moves by translate(12 6), producing 52295 changed pixels. The delivery master was not modified. This is XML source editor round-trip + sharp/librsvg rendering, not GUI-editor acceptance. See qa/roundtrip-evidence.json.

text-overflow-reviewed.evidence: Root and QA reviewer visually inspected both original-size page PNGs and the final combined PNG. No visible text overflow or unintended clipping: long contact email, About introduction, three work-method columns, learning card, buttons and both footers fit their intended regions.

unexpected-overlap-reviewed.evidence: Root reviewed the final combined PNG after the CV-arrow correction; QA reviewer also viewed it and both source-page renders. No unintended element overlap. DK profile card, About columns/toolkit/background sections and contact email/three-link-card/guidance sections remain separated. Contact CV uses a downward arrow; LinkedIn/GitHub retain outbound arrows.

orphan-wrap-reviewed.evidence: Root and QA reviewer inspected deliberate heading, paragraph and list line breaks. No visible one-letter or one-character orphan wrapping was found in either final page. The learning-topic disclaimer remains readable and separate from current-work claims.

canvas-ratio-reviewed.evidence: Root visually confirmed both complete 1024x1536 artboards, including header and footer. Actual XML/viewBox and PNG metadata match each page at 1024x1536 and the combined master at 2112x1536 with a 64-unit gap. See qa/svg-structure.json and qa/render-evidence.json.

limitations: No Penpot/draw.io GUI import, GUI editing or GUI reopening was tested.
All artwork is native SVG; DK is an intentional typographic profile card, not a photograph or generated portrait.
Buttons are visual descriptions only; M1 navigation, downloads, external destinations and contact behavior were not implemented or tested.
